name: Judging Other Christians
overview: Scripture instructs believers to avoid hypocritical and superficial judgment of fellow Christians, emphasizing that judging others can lead to self-condemnation since we are often guilty of similar faults (Romans 2:1). Jesus teaches not to judge harshly or according to outward appearances but to exercise righteous judgment (Matthew 7:1; John 7:24). Instead of condemning, believers are called to forgive and restore those caught in sin with humility and gentleness, mindful of their own vulnerability (Luke 6:37; Galatians 6:1). However, the New Testament also commands discernment by marking and avoiding those who cause division and oppose sound doctrine (Romans 16:17).
